intervention_names: Dietary Supplement: Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement Intervention
arm_groups.label: Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement Arm

brief_summary:
This is a single-group, open-label, decentralized clinical trial evaluating the effects of 12 weeks of once-daily consumption of Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement on nutritional adequacy, body composition, skin health, satiety, and overall wellness in 40 adults aged 18-55 years who are currently using a GLP-1 receptor agonist or dual-incretin medication for weight management. All study activities are conducted remotely; participants complete questionnaire assessments and smart scale body composition measurements at home at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12.

Participants replace a typical meal once daily with the study product for 12 consecutive weeks while continuing their existing GLP-1 or dual-incretin medication. The primary objective is to evaluate within-participant change in perceived nutritional adequacy from Baseline to Week 12. Secondary objectives include changes in body fat percentage, muscle mass, perceived skin health, hunger and satiety, hair health, energy and cognitive focus, nail health, gut comfort, metabolism support, physical strength, and product tolerability and satisfaction.
brief_title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement on Nutritional Adequacy, Body Composition, Skin Health, Satiety, and Overall Wellness in Adults Using GLP-1 or Dual-Incretin Medications for Weight Management

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18-55 years at the time of enrollment.
* Currently using a GLP-1 receptor agonist or dual-incretin medication for weight management (e.g., semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide) for a minimum of 4 weeks at the time of enrollment, with a stable or documented dose (no dose change within the 4 weeks prior to enrollment).
* Self-reported interest in supporting weight management, lean muscle maintenance, nutritional adequacy, or beauty-related benefits (e.g., skin, hair, nails) during GLP-1 therapy.
* Willing and able to use Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement as a once-daily meal replacement (replacing a typical meal) for 12 consecutive weeks and to complete all questionnaire assessments and Withings smart scale body composition measurements at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12.
* Willing and able to maintain current GLP-1 or dual-incretin medication dose throughout the study duration without planned dose adjustments (except in the event of a medically indicated change).
* Willing to maintain current diet (except for the study product), exercise routine, and lifestyle habits for the duration of the 12-week study, without introducing any new supplements or products specifically targeting weight loss, appetite, or body composition.
* In good general health.
* Resides in the United States.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding at the time of enrollment, or planning to become pregnant during the 12-week study period.
* Known allergy or intolerance to any ingredient in the Glow Shakes formulation, including milk, whey, or collagen-derived ingredients.
* Diagnosed with a serious medical condition requiring medical nutritional management, including but not limited to Type 1 diabetes, active cancer, or severe renal or hepatic disease.
* Currently testing, or plan to in the next 12 weeks, a product for another research study.
